verdict.rationale: The product's own docs mention ongoing monitoring that raises risk alerts on its own, plus configurable screening workflows that complete asynchronously and emit WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks. That amounts to background processing the vendor performs after setup. However, there is no documented user-configurable automation builder, scheduling, or rule-triggered actions; async and batch screening are API processing modes rather than autonomous automations. Missing for 10: user-defined automation rules or triggers, scheduled or recurring jobs, autonomous actions such as auto-resolving or auto-routing cases, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
